example.title: Bridge on Sage Road over Sicily Creek
example.place: half a mile east of Nebraska Highway 112, rural Gage County, NE
example.source: Wikimedia Commons (Category:Sicily Creek Sage Road bridge (Gage County, Nebraska))

brief: One-lane riveted steel Warren pony truss (with verticals) on a gravel county road in open farm country: channel top chord and end posts with gusset plates, angle web members, a plank deck of transverse boards, and angle rails through the truss web. Yellow-and-black hazard markers at all four corners and a WEIGHT LIMIT sign on the approach; flat fields and a farmstead nearby.
